messages:
zoe.r: Quick thread  saw ~30 owner flips during HS surge at 11:10. opening to capture a safe mitigation.

dan: any sample? webhook dupes or late enrichment?

zoe.r: sample: 11:10:02 lead-22 -> A, 11:10:08 -> B, enrichment arrived 11:10:45. HubSpot shows duplicate delivery id on retry.

harry: sounds like narrow splay + retries. propose a short circuit: if assign_count > 2 within 90s -> mark hold_for_180s and route to overflow_pool. VIPs bypass.

ops-bot: alert-signal: created rule -> #support when assign_count > 2 within 90s.

gina: also add idempotency header handling for HS webhooks (5s dedupe) and a sticky_affinity (30s) for normal leads so subsequent updates don't re-run rotation immediately.

dan: plan: zoe -> small config toggle + PR, harry -> add overflow ticket payload, gina -> add webhook idempotency tests. smoke in staging 20m, then 5% canary tomorrow 09:00 PT.

zoe.r: I'll open PR now and include rollout notes + test checklist. ETA EOD.

harry: LGTM, add metric circuited_leads and reassigned_count_per_lead to monitor.

gina: will add unit tests and a short SDR note describing overflow behavior.

zoe.r: thanks team! will post results in PR comments. :thumbsup:
